cv9035dk.name: CV9035 DK
cv9035dk.authority: Main ruled the Denmark line on 2026-10-29 (about 12:50, DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("add a bunch more denmark tanks"): CV9035 DK at tier V (the in-service vehicle, not the MkIIIC on order), the CV90 family's build with the 35 mm Bushmaster III and the Danish fit; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
cv9035dk.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the CV90 build with the Danish turret fit: the heavier 35 mm Bushmaster III with its long slotted muzzle brake, the muzzle level with the bow (r4: the Latvia side photograph), laser-warning heads in place of the roof weapon station (the Danish vehicles carry none), and the Danish coat, as the Holstebro photograph of 75.117 (2024, CC0) shows.
